lines.zh: 我悬在你头顶，嗡嗡地跟着。
lines.en: I hover above your head, humming along.
Four small rotors spin fast.

lines.zh: 我个子很小，风一吹就偏。
lines.en: I'm tiny; one gust pushes me off course.
I circle you and won't leave.

lines.zh: 我往上升，再往下降一点。
lines.en: I rise, then drop a little.

lines.zh: 我的推进器响得像虫子。
lines.en: My thrusters whine like an insect.

lines.zh: 我飞在你右肩上方，那里挡风。
lines.en: I fly above your right shoulder where it's sheltered.
I skim the ground looking for a landing spot.
I fly badly and hit walls often.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，是因为你在流血。
lines.en: I follow you because you're bleeding.
I rotate half a turn and steady myself.
The whole way I've been scanning you.

lines.zh: 我最后停在你头顶半米处。
lines.en: I stop at last half a metre above you.

lines.zh: 我的灯在暗处一闪一闪。
lines.en: My light blinks in the dark.
I hover, rotors never still.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，只是在等。
lines.en: I do nothing. Only wait.
My charge is still enough.

lines.zh: 我绕着自己转了一圈检查。
lines.en: I spin once to check myself.

lines.zh: 我发的小弹丸，是给人治伤的。
lines.en: My little bolts heal, not hurt.
No injuries nearby needing attention.

lines.zh: 我悬在树荫下，机身发凉。
lines.en: I hover in shade and my frame cools.
I sweep the area once.

lines.zh: 我的外壳上有几道划痕。
lines.en: A few scratches on my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢降到地面又升起。
lines.en: I dip to the ground and rise again.
My indicator has gone green.
I'm waiting for someone to get hurt.
You're bleeding. I'm here.
Don't swat. I'm not a bug.

lines.zh: 我停在你肩膀上方，别动。
lines.en: I'll stop above your shoulder. Hold still.
I haven't much medicine. Use it sparingly.

lines.zh: 你看起来有点晃，坐下吧。
lines.en: You look unsteady. Sit down.
Goblins made me. Don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 我的灯亮着，就表示我在。
lines.en: My light on means I'm here.
This wound is worse than last time.
Two loops, and the pellet flies to you.
You're looking better.
One of my rotors has stopped.
I wobbled before steadying.
Shell's dented. Doesn't affect flight.

lines.zh: 你血少了，我就飞过去补。
lines.en: When your health drops, I fly over to patch it.
I've lost a screw.
Pain isn't a word I understand well.
I can still fly. Don't mind me.
My beep has gone raspy.
I'll land and check myself.
This damage is survivable.
That copper dust — I could use it.
Are those parts in your hand?
My rotor shaft is a little loose.
A fresh cell would let me fly longer.
Hold it up and I'll come close to look.
I know this. Very useful.

lines.zh: 我得先顾你的伤，等会儿再说。
lines.en: Your wound comes first. Later.
I've drifted a little that way.
Keep it for now. Noted.
Right. Once you stop bleeding.

lines.zh: 被撞一下，我转了好几圈。
lines.en: One hit and I spun several turns.
My rotor shaft clicked.
I rise quickly to clear you.

lines.zh: 你手一挥，我就飞出两米。
lines.en: One wave of your hand and I'm two metres off.
I've steadied. Still flying.
I slip past your elbow.

lines.zh: 撞一下就晃，我机身太轻。
lines.en: One bump and I wobble. I'm too light.
My shell has a small dent.
I'll back off so I'm not in your way.
No harm. I can still work.

lines.zh: 我是台机器，没有那种设定。
lines.en: I'm a machine. Not built for that.
My task is only to watch over you.

lines.zh: 另一台无人机也在这附近。
lines.en: Another drone is in the area too.

lines.zh: 我们之间是信号，不是感情。
lines.en: Between us it's signals, not feeling.

lines.zh: 你要真需要，我就一直在。
lines.en: If you need it, I'll stay.

lines.zh: 我换块电池，就能多陪你一程。
lines.en: A new cell means I keep you company longer.

lines.zh: 这问题超出我的功能了。
lines.en: That's beyond my functions.
I only know where it hurts and how to fix it.
Don't touch my rotors. They'd break.
While you live, I have work.
This copper scrap — I'll keep it.
I pick it up with my little gripper.
This part could fix my rotor.

lines.zh: 我这点螺旋桨，抬不起它。
lines.en: These rotors can't lift that.

lines.zh: 这颗螺丝，归我的零件盒。
lines.en: This screw goes in my parts box.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我扫了一遍。
lines.en: I scan whatever's on the ground.
Do not pick that up. It is my screw.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进机身的小格。
lines.en: I tuck it into a small bay in my frame.
I can't use it, but you can.
Tucked away. Don't lose it.
Your health is dropping.

lines.zh: 我扫描到你身上的伤口。
lines.en: I've located the wound on you.
Hold still. Coming in.
This angle is the steadiest for applying.

lines.zh: 我锁定的是你的伤，不是你。
lines.en: I'm locked on your wound, not you.
Three scrapes on your left.

lines.zh: 我得先把你按住，不然打偏。
lines.en: I need you still or I'll miss.
Don't turn. I'm at your nape.
Your breaths are shallow. I can hear them.
I see how low your health is.
This can't wait.
I'll count to three, then apply.
Found it, just under the shoulder blade.
Your knee's bleeding too.
I move to your front to line up.

lines.zh: 你走动的话，我就打偏了。
lines.en: If you keep moving I'll miss.
I aim the nozzle at the wound.
A little more to the side. Nearly.
I'm waiting for you to stand still.
The wind's pushing me off position.
A tiny drone circles your head.
From here I can see the whole wound.
Enough charge for two more.
Almost lined up.
Hold steady one second more.
There. Don't move.
I time it to your breathing.
Lift your arm a little; it's in the way.
I'm lowering my altitude.
I don't hit people. I heal them.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，是让你别动。
lines.en: If I bump you, it's to keep you still.
That was very light. Don't mind it.

lines.zh: 我推了推你的手，让开点。
lines.en: I nudge your hand aside.
I puff out a small cloud of medicine.
Don't swing. You'd knock me down.
I've no weapon. Only a medicine sac.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面，虽然很窄。
lines.en: I put myself in front of you, narrow as I am.
This much force moves no one.

lines.zh: 我只是想让你退后一点。
lines.en: I only want you to step back a little.

lines.zh: 我撞在你护甲上，弹开了。
lines.en: I hit your armor and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我打不过，但我能挡一下。
lines.en: I can't fight, but I can block once.

lines.zh: 我从工程师的工具箱里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the engineer's toolbox.

lines.zh: 我的灯一亮，就开始扫描。
lines.en: My light comes on and I start scanning.
I rise into the air and steady myself.
The air here smells of powder.

lines.zh: 我绕着这块地飞了一圈。
lines.en: I fly one circuit of this ground.

lines.zh: 造我就是为了替你挡伤。
lines.en: I was built to take hits for you.
My rotors are turning smoothly.
First, somewhere I can perch.
Someone nearby is bleeding.
I give my first beep.
Windy here. I'll keep low.
Right. I'm starting work.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的外壳就变形。
lines.en: Fire warps my shell.
A rotor blade chipped off.

lines.zh: 水进了机身，我的翼转不动。
lines.en: Water gets in and my rotors seize.
The blast slams me into a tree.
Air is leaking from my left wing.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的电路乱跳。
lines.en: That force makes my circuits jump.
Charge is low; my light dims.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我冒了烟。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I smoke.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有气流，我推不动。
lines.en: No airflow in the void. My thrusters can't push.
